provenance.note: Siamese rows are the shipped checkpoint's measurement, transcribed from logs/rtx_session/judge_v5f.log (the run that produced weights/driftsense_v5f_e23.pt, since promoted to driftsense.pt). That run used --no-baseline, so the checkpoint-independent ZNCC rows are carried over from the earlier baseline run. This file predates the --gt-frame flag and is therefore corrected-frame only; re-running regenerates it in both frames.
provenance.regenerate_with: python evaluate.py --splits data/test data/test_medium data/test_severe --weights weights/driftsense.pt --out results
